self-imposed "shoulds" — accepting that disabled is real, not a failure of
effort — frees capacity that perfectionism and internalized ableism were
consuming. Recovery plans that add more outings, socializing, or
conventional self-care rituals without checking fit can worsen deficit
when those activities are net-depleting for the person (see [social energy
as spendable capacity](social-energy-as-spendable-capacity.md)).
findings.message: Skill enables autonomous high-impact decisions without human-in-the-loop verification. Critical operations (destructive commands, financial transactions, data deletion) should require explicit user confirmation.
findings.remediation: Add human-in-the-loop confirmation for destructive, irreversible, or high-impact operations. Never auto-execute commands that modify files, send data, or alter system state.

this activity actually leave more headroom afterward, or does it just feel

whether that time is spent on restorative or cheap rest will show a
